description_en: Modifies the endpoint connection information of an ApsaraDB RDS instance in Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS集群系列实例的Endpoint连接地址信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-endpoint-address --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f0000 --db-instance-id rm-0000 --db-instance-endpoint-id ep-0000 --connection-string rm-uf6wjk50000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --vpc-id vpc-bp17xdic25d0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp12u14ecz0000 --private-ip-address 172.16.XX.XX --connection-string-prefix rm-bp181qoj4s34m330000 --port 3306 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceEndpointAddress

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated submissions. The value is generated by the client.

The value is an ASCII string that can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint ID of the instance. You can call DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints to query the endpoint ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例的Endpoint ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints查询
parameters.name: db_instance_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the instance to modify. The value can be an internal network or public endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的实例某个连接地址，可以是内网或外网连接地址
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the internal network connection
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the internal network connection
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the target endpoint. Only the prefix part of the ConnectionString parameter can be modified
parameters.help_zh: 目标连接地址的前缀。只能修改ConnectionString参数的前缀部分
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en: The port number of the target connection
parameters.name: port

DBInstanceEndpointId.description_en: The endpoint ID of the instance
